Text Appearing After Image:
With this machine, which weighs less than 100 lbs., two men and a boy, can sort and put in the wagon from 80 to 100 bushels an hour. The potatoes pass from the hopper into the cylinder, which should be turned very slow by a very lazy boy. Have him pick out the decayed and scabby potatoes as they pass through the hopper, otherwise he will want to go to sleep PRIGB, - - - $15.QG.
